# InstanceofCanBeUsed

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `InstanceofCanBeUsedInspection`

Testing an object's class through string comparisons or reflection-like
helpers (`get_class($o) === 'Foo'`, `is_a($o, 'Foo')`,
`in_array('Foo', class_parents($o))`, …) is slower and less readable than the
`instanceof` operator, and hides the class name from refactoring tools.
Suggest `instanceof` when the subject is known to be a non-string value and
the named class exists.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{10,11,12,13,14,15} [Before]
<?php

final class Invoice        {}
class Document             {}
class Receipt extends Document {}
interface Printable        {}

function check(Invoice $doc, Document $base, string $name, $loose) {
    return [
        'Invoice' === get_class($doc),
        get_class($doc) <> 'Receipt',
        get_parent_class($base) == "Document",
        \is_a($doc, 'Invoice', FALSE),
        is_subclass_of($base, 'Receipt'),
        in_array('Document', class_parents($base), true),

        get_class($base) === 'Document',
        (get_class($doc)) === 'Invoice',
        get_class($name) == 'Invoice',
        get_class($loose) == 'Invoice',
        is_a($doc, 'Invoice', true),
        is_a($doc, 'Foo'),
        is_a($doc, '\\Invoice'),
        is_a($doc, 'Printable'),
        in_array('Invoice', class_implements($name)),
    ];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

final class Invoice        {}
class Document             {}
class Receipt extends Document {}
interface Printable        {}

function check(Invoice $doc, Document $base, string $name, $loose) {
    return [
        $doc instanceof \Invoice,
        get_class($doc) <> 'Receipt',
        get_parent_class($base) == "Document",
        $doc instanceof \Invoice,
        is_subclass_of($base, 'Receipt'),
        in_array('Document', class_parents($base), true),

        get_class($base) === 'Document',
        (get_class($doc)) === 'Invoice',
        get_class($name) == 'Invoice',
        get_class($loose) == 'Invoice',
        is_a($doc, 'Invoice', true),
        is_a($doc, 'Foo'),
        is_a($doc, '\\Invoice'),
        is_a($doc, 'Printable'),
        in_array('Invoice', class_implements($name)),
    ];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 10: Prefer &#39;$doc instanceof \Invoice&#39;.</li>
<li>line 11: Consider &#39;!$doc instanceof \Receipt&#39; (not an exact equivalent).</li>
<li>line 12: Consider &#39;$base instanceof \Document&#39; (not an exact equivalent).</li>
<li>line 13: Prefer &#39;$doc instanceof \Invoice&#39;.</li>
<li>line 14: Consider &#39;$base instanceof \Receipt&#39; (not an exact equivalent).</li>
<li>line 15: Consider &#39;$base instanceof \Document&#39; (not an exact equivalent).</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "InstanceofCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore InstanceofCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection InstanceofCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
